limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board work performed.
Power-up value is unspecified; the testbench establishes known state using synchronous reset.
implementation: Four-bit register increments on each rising clock edge, wraps modulo 16, and resets to zero when synchronous active-high reset is asserted.
static_review: Original interface preserved; nonblocking sequential assignments; explicitly sized arithmetic; no additional ports or latency.
verification_coverage: 232 comparisons covering three full counting periods, wraparound, held reset, reset during counting and at count 15, falling-edge stability, and reset pulses between rising edges.
